title: Fragrance trade marketing, a yogurt brand, and a way in with Paris
intro: Four new roles today, none in LA this time. Two are at Interparfums, the Paris-linked fragrance group: a North America trade marketing job built around retailer and distributor partnerships, and an entry-level marketing seat that works directly with the French headquarters. There's also an Associate Brand Manager job at your level for siggi's (owned by France's Lactalis) and a global social media role at Kiehl's (L'Oréal).

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Verified live Oct 20 on LinkedIn and L'Oréal's careers site.

notes: Hermès has a Manager – Special Events opening in Manhattan that works with the Hermès International office in Paris. It asks for 5 years in a similar event-production role and includes managing a coordinator, so it isn't numbered.
Lactalis's Karoun Dairies has a Trade Marketing Manager role in San Fernando (LA County), but it asks for at least 5 years of trade or brand marketing, so it isn't numbered.
Publicis Media (160over90) has an Olympic Account Manager, Partnerships role (Beverly Hills or NY, $70k–$90k), but it asks for 5–7 years of sponsorship account management, so it isn't numbered.
Ubisoft (French) has an entry-level US Communications Specialist role in San Francisco ($85k–$92k), but it's gaming-press PR built on knowing the games media world, so it isn't numbered.

SMCP Group: Greenhouse still shows only retail roles plus NY finance and planning, with no US marketing, brand, or partnerships roles. Moët Hennessy, Pernod Ricard, Sol de Janeiro, and CHANEL posted no new US marketing roles at your level.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Manager, North America
jobs.work_arrangement: In the office Monday–Thursday, remote on Fridays
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Interparfums, Inc. owns most of Interparfums SA in Paris (the same group as your earlier #11).
jobs.travel: The posting says the job may require travel to company locations, clients, vendors, and industry events. It doesn't mention Paris.
jobs.why: A partnerships-heavy marketing job: you'd work with Sales, distributors, and the field team on retailer plans, present at key US retailer and distributor meetings, and run launch calendars and in-store events for prestige fragrance brands. Your QBRs and account planning carry over well. The posting also says the company has a low hierarchy with regular visibility to the C-suite.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in integrated or trade marketing in the US market. Beauty experience is strongly preferred, and Adobe Suite is required.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager – siggi's
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days a week in the Bedford office
jobs.french_tie: Lactalis is a family-owned French dairy group (the world's largest dairy company, per the posting). siggi's is one of its US yogurt brands.
jobs.why: A real brand management job at about your level: brand plans, campaigns across digital, social, and in-store, and consumer programs built on events, partnerships, and promotions. The posting calls it a small, entrepreneurial team and encourages applying even if you don't meet every qualification.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 1–3 years of brand or product marketing (CPG preferred). Your marketing internships and your partnership work at Gartner are what you'd point to.

image.source: https://www.lactalis.com/ (site header logo, Lactalis-logo.svg on Lactalis's Contentful CDN)

jobs.title: Marketing Administrator
jobs.work_arrangement: Based in the Manhattan office (the posting doesn't mention hybrid)
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Part of the Paris-based Interparfums group. The posting says you'd work with the French headquarters offices and handle e-commerce for two French fragrance houses, Annik Goutal and Solferino.
jobs.why: An entry-level way into a French luxury fragrance team that works directly with Paris: retailer and sales-meeting decks, events and conferences, the digital asset pipeline, and support for PR and influencer gifting. It reports to the Marketing VP.
jobs.stretch_note: It's an entry-level, partly administrative job, so it would be a step down in seniority from your AE role. Weigh that against getting a foot in the door.

jobs.title: Manager, Kiehl's Global Social Media
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Kiehl's Since 1851 is in the L'Oréal Luxe division.
jobs.why: A global brand team: social-first campaigns for Kiehl's worldwide launches, creator and agency management, and playbooks and toolkits for markets around the world, working with Global Marketing, Comms, and regional teams.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years in social media, content marketing, or creative production, with hands-on social campaign experience.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Westfield Topanga
jobs.location: Canoga Park (Los Angeles), CA, per the posting text; LinkedIn's location tag says Paramus, NJ, so confirm when you apply
jobs.work_arrangement: On site at the center (the posting describes hands-on onsite marketing and Manager-on-Duty coverage)
jobs.french_tie: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield is headquartered in Paris; Westfield is its shopping-center brand in the US.
jobs.why: Still open and still your only LA pick from this week: Westfield Topanga marketing with retailer, community, and influencer partnerships.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in shopping center, retail, real estate, hospitality, or related marketing roles. The posting says there's no 'perfect' candidate and encourages applying even if you don't meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Field Marketing – Champagne & Sparkling (NYC)
jobs.work_arrangement: 3 days a week in the NYC office, plus in market as the business needs
jobs.french_tie: Moët Hennessy (LVMH, Paris HQ); the role runs local programming for the Champagne & Sparkling portfolio.
jobs.why: Still open, and still the best level match from this week: your sales years count toward the 3+ years.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25%; posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open, and still the most realistic-level L'Oréal role (1–3 years required).

jobs.title: Manager, Retail Marketing – Americas
jobs.french_tie: Sol de Janeiro is part of L'Occitane Group (founded in Provence), and the posting says the brand has a team in Paris.
jobs.why: Still open: retailer partnerships with the Sales and Key Account teams.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years in marketing (beauty preferred).

jobs.title: Manager, Consumer Engagement – Americas
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days a week at the NYC HQ
jobs.french_tie: Sol de Janeiro is part of L'Occitane Group (founded in Provence), and the posting says the brand has a team in Paris.
jobs.why: Still open: consumer, influencer, and trade events across the Americas.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–6 years of marketing experience (beauty preferred) and strong agency leadership experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Advocacy and Influence — Biolage
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home), per the posting
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Biolage is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically (25%); posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open: creator and advocacy work for Biolage on the professional haircare side.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years in marketing, branding, or product management.
